title: Investigating the Academic Performance and Disciplinary Consequences of School District Internet Access Spending
eligible_reason: Continuous treatment (log(1+SDIAS), school district internet-access spending) in a school-year panel with school and year fixed effects, time-varying controls, IV (E-rate reimbursement), and conditional fixed-effects Poisson for disciplinary outcomes. No binary adoption design.
design_notes: JMR 58(1), 2021. Texas schools 2000-2014 (about 9,124 schools, 1,243 districts). Tables 3 and 4 (academic outcomes, FE + controls + IV), Table 7 (interaction of log(1+SDIAS) with a binary household-internet indicator), Tables 8-9 (Poisson). The Bertrand-Duflo-Mullainathan citation concerns clustering.
screener_notes: Not eligible. Continuous treatment, IV, Poisson, time-varying controls. Sources named in text are public (USAC E-rate data, TEA/AEIS and TAPR, FCC Form 477, Census), but no package was provided. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
